items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: But anyway, yeah, Kenny told me, he said one time he was on one of those jazz cruises

ctx.x: Oh boy do I miss him, I wish he was around. But anyway, yeah, Kenny told me, he said one time he was on one of those jazz cruises and they told the band, you know, you’ll eat with the customers, everything. Well of course every time they went to eat in the restaurant they never got called. Their table never got called. And so there they are with all these great guys and they’re just ignoring him so he told me he says, “Man I went up to the microphone to announce and I said, ‘Christ, party of 12.’” Anyway so the…

this wonderful. There’s two people, boy, they do everything you know. Who wants to give real money to that? So the board and I decided you know it was time to really hire an administrator, administrative staff, and now we have a full time staff of four or five, a great administrator, a lot of consultants, and our artistic directors are John Bastiste and Christian McBride. And we’re about to enter our third decade.
